units.source_text: 河面上漂浮着不少的小船。

en.t: Quite a few small boats were floating on the surface of the river.

units.source_text: 我们一行人沿着浪河路而行。

en.t: Our group walked along Naga River Road.

units.source_text: 我们走进道路尽头的龟山公园的门口，看见满地都是纸屑，就知道今年公园的游客稀少了。

en.t: When we reached the entrance of Kameyama Park at the end of the road and saw paper scraps scattered all over the ground, we knew that visitors to the park had been few that year.
